import secrets
import msal


def start_oauth_login(payload, config=None):
    config = config or {}
    app = msal.ConfidentialClientApplication(
        config['client_id'], authority=f"https://login.microsoftonline.com/{config['tenant_id']}",
        client_credential=config['client_secret'])
    state = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
    url = app.get_authorization_request_url(config.get('scopes', ['User.Read']),
        redirect_uri=payload['redirect_uri'], state=state)
    return {'authorization_url': url, 'session_id': state}

+import hashlib
+import base64
+import secrets
+
+import msal
+
+from identity_client import load_identity_config, default_scopes
+
+
+def _challenge(verifier: str) -> str:
+    digest = hashlib.sha256(verifier.encode('utf-8')).digest()
+    return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(digest).decode('utf-8').rstrip('=')
+
+
+def pkce_login(payload, config=None):
+    config = config or load_identity_config()
+    verifier = secrets.token_urlsafe(64)
+    app = msal.PublicClientApplication(
+        config['client_id'],
+        authority=f"https://login.microsoftonline.com/{config['tenant_id']}",
+    )
+    flow = app.initiate_auth_code_flow(scopes=config.get('scopes', default_scopes()), redirect_uri=payload['redirect_uri'])
+    flow['code_verifier'] = verifier
+    flow['code_challenge'] = _challenge(verifier)
+    return {'authorization_url': flow['auth_uri'], 'state': flow['state'], 'code_verifier': verifier}
+
